salary_structures_pct_range.name: salary_structures_pct_range
salary_structures_pct_range.value:
"salary_structures"."basic_pct" between 0 and 100
        and "salary_structures"."house_pct" between 0 and 100
        and "salary_structures"."medical_pct" between 0 and 100
        and "salary_structures"."conveyance_pct" between 0 and 100
        and "salary_structures"."basic_pct" + "salary_structures"."house_pct" + "salary_structures"."medical_pct" + "salary_structures"."conveyance_pct" <= 100

leave_requests_decision_recorded.name: leave_requests_decision_recorded
leave_requests_decision_recorded.value: ("leave_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "leave_requests"."decided_by" is null and "leave_requests"."decided_at" is null) or ("leave_requests"."status" <> 'pending' and "leave_requests"."decided_by" is not null and "leave_requests"."decided_at" is not null)
